correctness.rationale: Directly from the ordered overlapping-read definition, a missing nonconstant pair gives a unique reconstructable inconsistency; a missing constant pair corresponds to shortening a run. Hence shared outputs yield precisely positive-composition unit transfers, and each consistent shorter word has one parent per run. The component size, degree double-count and walk matrix spectral identity prove every n and q case including short exceptions. An independent explicit enumeration of all read vectors verifies 270 parameter/adapter cases but the proof does not rely on extrapolation.
